primer: Vertex Pharmaceuticals (NASDAQ: VRTX) is an orphan-disease biotech compounder anchored by a near-monopoly cystic fibrosis (CF) franchise. Trikafta and once-daily Alyftrek carry patent protection through 2037–2039 and generate $12.00B in annual sales at 85.6% gross margins. Management is scaling four new pillars: Casgevy, Journavx, Palsonify, and povetacicept. At the $536.45 session close (Stage 3 Topping / Pullback), VRTX sits above its $514.95–$530.63 support zone with 1.41:1 CMP R:R, earning WAIT_FOR_SUPPORT ($487.75 stop, $605.00 base target).
